work.question: Am I employed or self-employed?
work.answer: Employed. You're on our payroll, we deduct your tax and National Insurance, and you get a payslip.

work.question: Do I have to take shifts?
work.answer: No. Take the work that suits you.

work.question: Do I need experience?
work.answer: For bar and silver service, yes. For runners and porters, no.

hire/bar-staff.question: Can your bar staff work to our cocktail list?
hire/bar-staff.answer: Yes. Send it with your enquiry and it goes into the brief.

hire/bar-staff.question: How late can the bar run?
hire/bar-staff.answer: As late as your licence allows. Give us the real finish time.

hire/bar-staff.question: Can you cover a shift at short notice?
hire/bar-staff.answer: Ask whatever the date. We take a lot of overflow work.

hire/kitchen-porters.question: What does a kitchen porter cover?
hire/kitchen-porters.answer: Wash-up through service, bins and waste, and the clear down. Tell us about any prep.

hire/kitchen-porters.question: Can you cover early starts and long days?
hire/kitchen-porters.answer: Yes. Give us the real call and finish times.

hire/kitchen-porters.question: Can we book the same porters every week?
hire/kitchen-porters.answer: Where the pattern is regular, we send the same people.

hire/production-catering.question: Can you cover a 5am call time?
hire/production-catering.answer: Yes. Send the call sheet times when you enquire.

hire/production-catering.question: Can we have the same crew for the whole shoot?
hire/production-catering.answer: That's the aim. Tell us the shoot dates up front.

hire/production-catering.question: How are cooks and chefs charged?
hire/production-catering.answer: Quoted individually, by section and unit size.

hire/cleaners.question: When do your cleaners work?
hire/cleaners.answer: Before the doors open, during service, or once the last guest has gone. Book one shift or all three.

hire/cleaners.question: Do they bring cleaning kit?
hire/cleaners.answer: Tell us what the venue has. Cleaning kit and consumables are quoted on the brief if you need us to bring them.

hire/cleaners.question: How are cleaners priced?
hire/cleaners.answer: Quoted on the brief, by headcount, hours and the size of the job.

hire/security.question: Are your security staff licensed?
hire/security.answer: Yes. Anyone we send to a licensable security role holds a current SIA licence, and we check it before they're booked.

hire/security.question: How many security staff do we need?
hire/security.answer: It depends on guest numbers, the venue, alcohol and the licence conditions. Send the brief and we'll recommend a number.

hire/security.question: How is security priced?
hire/security.answer: Quoted on the brief, by headcount, hours and the type of event.

hire/front-of-house.question: What can front of house staff cover?
hire/front-of-house.answer: Greeting, guest lists and wristbands, cloakroom, seating guests and running between rooms. Tell us what the night needs.

hire/front-of-house.question: Are hosts the same rate as waiting staff?
hire/front-of-house.answer: Yes. Hosts, runners, waiting and bar staff share one rate and can go on one booking.

hire/front-of-house.question: Can they match our dress code?
hire/front-of-house.answer: Yes. Send it with the brief and they arrive dressed for it.

hire/event-chefs.question: Do your chefs plan the menu?
hire/event-chefs.answer: They cook to your menu or your caterer's. For the food planned and handled too, see full events.

hire/event-chefs.question: Can you send kitchen porters with them?
hire/event-chefs.answer: Yes. Chefs and kitchen porters go on the same booking, so the wash-up is covered.

hire/event-chefs.question: How are chefs priced?
hire/event-chefs.answer: From {{CHEF_FROM_RATE}}/hr per chef. The menu, the hours and the kind of kitchen set the rate, and we agree it before you book.

hire/private-parties.question: Do you staff parties at home?
hire/private-parties.answer: Yes, at houses, gardens and flats as well as hired venues. Tell us about access and the kitchen.

hire/private-parties.question: How many staff do we need?
hire/private-parties.answer: Tell us guest numbers, how drinks and food are served, and the timings. We'll recommend a team.

hire/private-parties.question: Do you bring the drinks and glasses?
hire/private-parties.answer: On a staff booking we send people only. For food and drink too, see full events.

hire/corporate-events.question: How many staff can you supply?
hire/corporate-events.answer: Send the event, guest numbers and service style. We confirm the team we can put in before you book.

hire/corporate-events.question: Will there be someone in charge of our team?
hire/corporate-events.answer: Yes, if you want one, and we recommend it on larger teams. Supervisors are quoted separately.

hire/corporate-events.question: Can we mix roles on one booking?
hire/corporate-events.answer: Yes. Waiting, bar, kitchen porters, runners and hosts share one rate; cleaners and security join the same booking, quoted separately.

hire/waiting-staff.question: How many waiting staff do we need?
hire/waiting-staff.answer: Tell us guest numbers, service style and timings. We'll recommend a team.

hire/waiting-staff.question: Do they know the running order before they arrive?
hire/waiting-staff.answer: Yes. Send it and it goes into their brief.

hire/waiting-staff.question: Can we ask for the same staff again?
hire/waiting-staff.answer: Yes, by name. Anyone who wasn't right won't be sent again.

hire/weddings.question: Our venue is dry hire. Can you staff the whole day?
hire/weddings.answer: Yes, dry hire is a lot of what we do. Build the team the day needs.

hire/weddings.question: How many staff will our wedding need?
hire/weddings.answer: Send guest numbers, service style and running order. We'll recommend a team.

hire/weddings.question: Who do the staff take direction from?
hire/weddings.answer: Whoever you tell us: planner, caterer, venue or you.

special-events/christmas.question: Do you staff New Year's Eve?
special-events/christmas.answer: Sometimes. It's the busiest night of the year, so send us the date and we'll tell you what we can do.

special-events/christmas.question: How late can we book?
special-events/christmas.answer: Ask whatever the date. Enquire between 8am and 10pm and you'll have confirmed names back the same day.

special-events/christmas.question: What if someone doesn't turn up?
special-events/christmas.answer: We'll have a replacement on site within the hour. If we can't, that shift isn't charged.

special-events/new-years-eve.question: Why is New Year's Eve quoted rather than priced?
special-events/new-years-eve.answer: It's the busiest night of the year for event staff. We quote on the date, the hours and the team you need.

special-events/new-years-eve.question: How early should we book?
special-events/new-years-eve.answer: As early as you can. Send the date now, even without numbers, and we'll hold what we can.

special-events/new-years-eve.question: Can the team stay past midnight?
special-events/new-years-eve.answer: Yes. Tell us the finish time and we'll staff the night through to close and clear-down.
